title: Clarinet and classical overtures
summary: He played clarinet well and the classics; he cannot recall titles such as Light Cavalry.

story.theme_name: Late-career reflections: awards, legacy and life lessons
story.community_name: Hunting for old band photographs and scrapbooks

blocks.x: Did you ever get to be good on clarinet before you quit playing?
No, that's pretty good. That's how you play the magic.
Like what? You play classics? Yeah. Do you remember any of the names of them?
Yeah, no. No, I'm trying to tell them. Oh yeah. Overture as well. Yeah, all the pieces. I can't call the name. Oh shit, I can't call the name.
Yeah, all that sort of stuff.
Yeah. And, uh, and, um, boy, I used to like it and they can't call the names to save my life. I hope that was hard. But I can't call the name more. Can you hum it? Huh?
No, I can't hum it. It's a pretty moment.
